data.one_liner: Provides localized strings for Firebase UI Auth, Firestore and Database widgets.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies ready‑made translations for Firebase UI components and a workflow to add new languages. It integrates with Flutter's localization system so UI widgets automatically display the correct language.
use_when: You are using firebase_ui_auth, firebase_ui_firestore or firebase_ui_database and need multilingual support out of the box.
You want a simple way to add or extend translations without writing your own localization files.
avoid_when: You already have a custom localization solution covering all needed strings.
The app only targets a single language and adding this package adds unnecessary overhead.
strengths: Simple CLI tools to add labels or new languages
Keeps localization in sync with Firebase UI updates
weaknesses: Tied to specific Firebase UI versions; breaking changes may require updates
Limited to the strings provided by Firebase UI
Adds a code‑gen step to the build process
data.setup_notes: Add the package, then run `dart run firebase_ui_localizations:gen_l10n` (or `add_label` then `gen_l10n`) to generate the localization files.
